subject: LiteFolio: IAM artifact package + role-activation timeline
messages:
From: compliance@litefolio.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: LiteFolio IAM artifacts needed for SIG review

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Our security team asked for the following artifacts to complete the SIG/SOC2 intake:
- Recent SAML assertion samples showing the NameID format and groups claim (preferably 2-3 examples)
- SCIM full-sync snapshot (UTC run time last month) and a brief note on delta behavior
- Role activation history for service accounts and human admins going back 90 days
- Least-privilege mapping for console roles vs API scopes

Can you confirm a delivery date? We are on a tight review window — ideally before EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Compliance Lead, LiteFolio
compliance@litefolio.com

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: compliance@litefolio.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LiteFolio IAM artifacts needed for SIG review

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Quick plan below and a couple of clarifying Qs:

Plan (deliverables by Wednesday EOD - 2028-11-02):
1) SAML assertion samples (3 examples) — attached as saml-assertion-samples.txt; includes signed SamlResponse headers with redacted NameIDs and claims.
2) SCIM snapshot CSV from our full periodic sync run on 2028-10-30 — attached as scim-sync-snapshot-2028-10-30.csv. Note field mapping and a short README in the Drive link.
3) Role activation timeline (human & service accounts, last 90 days) — attached XLSX. Includes timestamped activation events and requestor IDs.
4) Least-privilege mapping PDF that maps console roles to API scopes + recommended pruning.

Clarifying Qs:
- For role activation, do you need the raw audit log entries or an exported timeline (we can provide both; timeline is easier to digest)?
- SCIM delta behavior: do you want the delta log for a specific SCIM client or the summary of delta types (create/update/delete) across tenants?

We will include a short one-page cover note explaining how our SCIM and SSO flows handle account state and justifications for role mappings.

Flagging for Neha and Rishi to confirm the attachments and sign-off on the least-privilege doc.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-01T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LiteFolio IAM artifacts needed for SIG review

Jordan — I reviewed the exports. A few notes before we send to LiteFolio:
- SCIM snapshot: redacted email addresses for accounts marked PII in the snapshot and replaced with hashed tokens; add a README row that documents hashing scheme.
- Role activation timeline: include whether activation was via console approval flow or automated service onboarding. That column is useful for auditors.
- Least-privilege mapping: mark three roles as "legacy-high-priv" that we recommend pruning over the next quarter; add suggested migration steps.

I'll attach small edits to the XLSX and the mapping PDF; Rishi, can you confirm the scoping text for the SCIM delta behavior?

Neha Kapoor
Security Compliance Manager
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-01T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LiteFolio IAM artifacts needed for SIG review

Confirmed — SCIM delta behavior summary added to the Drive README. Key points:
- Full sync runs nightly; deltas are pushed in near-real time for provisioning clients that subscribe to the webhook.
- Delta types are tagged (CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE) and we keep a 60-day delta log for audit retrieval.
- For external auditors we can provide a redacted delta sample on request (we've prepared one).

I'll upload the revised README and a redacted delta sample to the Drive link in a minute.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Platform Engineer
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: auditor@thirdpartyaudit.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@litefolio.com
Date: 2028-11-03T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: RE: LiteFolio IAM artifacts needed for SIG review

Jordan,

Received the package and the Drive link. We reviewed the timeline and the SCIM notes — everything looks good for the intake. A couple of small follow-ups before we close the request:
- Could you include one raw audit log line (redacted IP and session token) corresponding to one role activation event in the XLSX? That helps validate ingestion.
- For the SAML samples, please indicate which assertion corresponds to an IdP-initiated flow vs SP-initiated flow (a single-line annotation next to each sample is fine).

Apologies — this is granular but speeds the SIG review. If you can drop these two items by EOD Monday, we can move to final QA.

Thanks for the quick turnaround,
Elena Morales
Senior Auditor, ThirdPartyAudit
auditor@thirdpartyaudit.com
